Hanno Chamber of Commerce and Industry will hold expert consultations in September and October.

September consultation dates:
• September 9 (Wed) 1:30 p.m. – Business succession and M&A consultation
• September 10 (Thu) 9:30 a.m. – Tax and invoice system consultation
• September 11 (Fri) 10:00 a.m. – Personnel and labor consultation
• September 15 (Tue) 1:30 p.m. – Business law consultation and Japan Finance Corporation consultation
• September 28 (Tue) 10:00 a.m. – Intellectual property consultation

October consultation dates:
• October 8 (Thu) 9:30 a.m. – Tax and invoice system consultation
• October 9 (Fri) 10:00 a.m. – Personnel and labor consultation
• October 14 (Wed) 1:30 p.m. – Business succession and M&A consultation
• October 15 (Tue) 1:30 p.m. – Japan Finance Corporation consultation
• October 19 (Mon) 10:00 a.m. – Intellectual property consultation
• October 20 (Tue) 1:30 p.m. – Business law consultation

All consultations are free and available to Hanno Chamber of Commerce and Industry members only. For tax, personnel and labor, and intellectual property consultations, the reservation deadline is 5 business days before the consultation date (by midday). To reserve, use the booking link on the Chamber of Commerce website.

Source (Japanese): https://www.hanno-cci.or.jp/xo_event/xo_event-2619/
